ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal intensity distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity pixels (white lobes) vs 35% low-intensity pixels (central black region and mottling).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity black wedge extends from the peduncle base. Left lobe features a large high-intensity white field containing a distinct, isolated curvilinear (C-shaped) black mark. Right lobe contains a high-intensity white field with dense, high-frequency black mottling along the interior trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 105 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern along the entire visible trailing edge; high-amplitude peaks (5-10 pixel depth) are most frequent on the interior half of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory on the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four parallel, vertical low-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) on the upper-left interior lobe; three diagonal low-intensity linear marks on the upper-right interior lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced rake mark scarring across both upper lobes, appearing as distinct parallel linear pigmentation breaks.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique semi-circular (C-shaped) pigmentation mark located in the center of the left lobe's high-intensity region.
